about: An offline-first app for testing web APIs, on the web and desktop.

prs.title: Requests copied from Chrome import with the right body
prs.broken: Chrome writes request bodies with quotes, line breaks or exclamation marks in a special shell form. Importing them cut the body off or filled it with stray backslash text.
prs.changed: I made the import decode that form before reading the command.
prs.matters: Requests copied from the browser's developer tools come in exactly as the page sent them.

prs.title: Imported commands keep their address when the get option comes first
prs.broken: Importing a command with the get option before the address left the address empty. That is how Stripe and other API docs write their list and search examples.
prs.changed: I made the import treat that option as a simple switch, so it no longer swallows the address.
prs.matters: Examples pasted straight from API docs import and run.
